metadata.name: clashy
metadata.description: Clashy: PvP trading games (knockout duels, clans, clan wars, tournaments) on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: abort_duel
docs: Anyone can end a duel that matched but never reached the rollup within DUEL_SETUP_SECS (a seed,
pick or VRF answer never came). If both picks were committed and only one player revealed, the
other forfeits: the revealer takes the pot minus rake. Otherwise both stakes are refunded.

instructions.name: call_round
docs: ER, player: calls up (1) or down (2) for the current round. Can be changed until the bell.

instructions.name: cancel_duel
docs: Refunds an unmatched duel: the creator any time, anyone after expiry. No rake.

instructions.name: cancel_tournament
docs: Creator cancels an unstarted tournament; remaining accounts are every player's USDC token account in join order.

instructions.name: cancel_war
docs: The declaring captain withdraws an unaccepted war; the stake goes back to the chest.

instructions.name: check_duel
docs: ER, permissionless (a crank or either player): scores both sides at the live price. When
someone is knocked out or the clock runs out, the duel finishes, is committed and goes home.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Captain closes a clan position at the oracle price; the P&L feeds the clan's score.

accounts.name: closer
docs: The captain, or anyone once the clan's war window is over.

accounts.name: war
docs: The clan's war, needed when someone other than the captain closes.

instructions.name: coin_roll_callback
docs: VRF callback (only the VRF program can call it): picks the coin from the duel's pool.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: commit_pick
docs: Seals a pick: hash = sha256(side || leverage_le || salt).

instructions.name: create_profile
docs: A player's handle and avatar. The handle account makes names unique.

instructions.name: delegate_channel
docs: Moves a channel onto the MagicBlock rollup, where members post for free and instantly.

instructions.name: delegate_duel
docs: Hands the duel to the ER once both picks are revealed.

accounts.name: player
docs: One of the duel's two players.

accounts.name: host
docs: The tournament's creator.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Captain executes a passed proposal at the oracle price: opens a scored clan position.
Passed = more yes than no, and either the window closed or yes holds over half of all shares.

accounts.name: war
docs: The clan's war, required while it is at war.

instructions.name: init_base_feed
docs: A never-delegated copy of a coin's feed on Solana, for Solana-side reads (clan trades).
MagicBlock sponsors only a few commits per delegated account, so the rollup feeds are not
committed back; the crank writes this account directly instead.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The stake currency (USDC).

instructions.name: leave_clan
docs: Leaves the clan. Withdraw your deposit first; the captain leaves last.

accounts.name: member
docs: Membership is proven by this account existing (seeds), not by the player's main squad.

instructions.name: like
docs: One like per player per post (by profile number).

instructions.name: open_duel
docs: Opens a duel and escrows the creator's stake. With a short expiry it is a quick-match
ticket; with a long one it is an open challenge on the board.

instructions.name: post
docs: Posts to the feed (players with a profile). A call points at a stock mint and the app shows the
author's live position in it; a reply points at the post it answers.

instructions.name: post_message
docs: Posts to a clan channel (members only). Runs inside the rollup.

accounts.name: member
docs: The author's membership in the channel's clan (the handler checks it is the same clan).

instructions.name: propose
docs: Group trading: a member proposes a trade on the chest.

instructions.name: push_base_price
docs: Crank-only, on Solana.

instructions.name: push_price
docs: Crank-only. Works on Solana and inside the ER (where the feed is delegated).

instructions.name: reject_proposal
docs: Anyone can close a proposal that failed once its window is over.

instructions.name: request_coin_roll
docs: Asks MagicBlock VRF (base-layer queue) to roll the coin for both players.

accounts.name: player
docs: One of the duel's two players.

instructions.name: request_tournament_coin
docs: Asks MagicBlock VRF to roll the tournament's coin (required on devnet / mainnet).

instructions.name: resolve_round
docs: ER, permissionless after the bell: wrong or missing calls lose a life. When one player (or
none) is left, or the last round ends, the tournament finishes and goes back to Solana.

instructions.name: reveal_seed
docs: Local fallback when no VRF oracle runs: both players reveal the seeds they committed at
open/join and the coin comes from sha256(seed_a || seed_b). Refused when VRF is required.

instructions.name: set_coin
docs: Sets coin `index` to read from `feed` (a Clashy PriceFeed or a MagicBlock oracle account).

instructions.name: set_er_validator
docs: Pins the rollup validator duels and tournaments are delegated to.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: The player's own controls. A lower daily limit applies at once; a higher one waits a day.

instructions.name: set_vrf_queue
docs: Points coin rolls at another MagicBlock VRF queue (it must be owned by the VRF program).

instructions.name: settle_duel
docs: Solana: pays the pot (minus rake) to the winner, or refunds both on a tie; updates ratings.

instructions.name: settle_war
docs: After the window: the clan with the better return (score change over starting chest) takes
the pot minus rake into its chest; a tie refunds both.

instructions.name: start_duel
docs: ER: sets the entry price from the live feed and starts the clock.

instructions.name: start_tournament
docs: ER, creator: starts round 1 at the live price.

instructions.name: stash_invest
docs: Buys a tokenized stock with USDC from the Stash, through Orca Whirlpool. The shares land in the
player's own token account; the cost is recorded on chain in their Holding.

instructions.name: stash_save
docs: Moves USDC from the player's wallet into their Stash. `kind` records where it came from:
put in by hand, a round-up on a payment made in the same transaction, or a slice of a win.

instructions.name: stash_sell
docs: Sells shares bought through the Stash back to USDC (into the Stash), through Orca Whirlpool.

instructions.name: stash_withdraw
docs: The owner can always take their savings out.

instructions.name: take_break
docs: A break from staking that the player sets on themselves. It can be extended, never shortened.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: void_duel
docs: Rollup, anyone: a live duel nobody could finish (the crank stalled, or nobody checked) is voided once its bell is
VOID_GRACE_SECS past. It ends as a draw and goes back to Solana, where settle_duel refunds both stakes with no rake,
so money can never be stuck on the rollup (audit M-H2).

instructions.name: void_tournament
docs: Solana: players left with the most lives split the pot minus rake. Remaining accounts are
every player's USDC token account in join order.
Rollup, anyone: a Royale whose round nobody could resolve (the crank stalled) ends VOID_GRACE_SECS after that round's
bell, with the players still on the most lives sharing the pot at settle, and goes back to Solana (audit M-H2).

instructions.name: vote
docs: Votes are weighted by the member's chest shares; one vote per member per proposal.

instructions.name: withdraw_chest
docs: Redeems `shares` of your chest shares for their pro-rata part of the chest, so war wins and
losses are shared by every member whatever order they leave in. Blocked while at war.

types.name: Board
docs: The public calls feed: the last BOARD_POSTS posts in a ring, live on the MagicBlock rollup.

types.name: Channel
docs: One clan channel: the last CHAT_MSGS messages in a ring. Delegated to the MagicBlock rollup, so
posting is instant and costs the player nothing; members of the clan only.

fields.name: count
docs: Messages ever posted; the newest sits at (count - 1) % CHAT_MSGS.

fields.name: chest
docs: USDC base units in the chest vault: members' deposits, minus war stakes lost, plus war pots won.

fields.name: shares
docs: Total chest shares held by members. A share is worth `chest / shares` USDC base units.

fields.name: score_pnl
docs: Realized paper P&L of the clan's voted trades, in USDC base units of notional.

fields.name: open_votes
docs: Proposals still open. Withdrawals wait until they close, so one deposit cannot vote twice.

fields.name: feed
docs: Price account for this coin: a Clashy `PriceFeed` (crank-pushed) or a MagicBlock oracle account.

fields.name: crank
docs: Pushes prices into Clashy feeds (a keeper reading a public price API).

fields.name: vrf_required
docs: When true (devnet / mainnet), coins are rolled only by MagicBlock VRF.
When false (local stack without a VRF oracle), a two-party commit-reveal roll is allowed.

fields.name: vrf_queue
docs: The MagicBlock VRF oracle queue coin rolls go to: the base queue on devnet and mainnet, or
MagicBlock's test queue on a local stack running their `vrf-oracle`.

fields.name: er_validator
docs: The MagicBlock rollup validator duels and tournaments may be delegated to (set by the admin).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The stake currency: every stake, chest, war pot and entry is this SPL mint (USDC).

fields.name: auth_bump
docs: Bump of the `auth` PDA that owns every vault token account.

types.name: Duel
docs: A 1v1 knockout duel. Stakes sit in the `vault` PDA on Solana; the duel itself is
delegated to the ER while it is live.

fields.name: pool_mask
docs: Bitmask over config coins the roll may pick.

fields.name: seed_hash
docs: Commit-reveal seeds for the local roll (unused when VRF rolls).

fields.name: pick_hash
docs: Sealed picks: sha256(side || leverage_le || salt).

fields.name: pnl_bps
docs: Leveraged P&L in basis points of stake, per player.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 none, 1 creator, 2 joiner, 3 tie.

fields.name: matched_at
docs: When the joiner matched; after DUEL_SETUP_SECS a duel stuck before the rollup can be aborted.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent for the duel and its vault (the sponsor); gets the vault's rent back when it closes.

types.name: Holding
docs: Shares of one tokenized stock bought through the Stash, with what they cost. The shares
themselves sit in the player's own token account; this records the cost basis on chain so
a position's profit can be shown without trusting the app.

fields.name: shares
docs: Raw token units bought and not yet sold through the Stash.

fields.name: cost
docs: USDC base units paid for those shares (reduced pro rata on sells).

fields.name: deposit
docs: USDC base units this member put in, net of withdrawals (cost basis, for display).

fields.name: shares
docs: Chest shares: withdrawals pay `shares * chest / clan.shares`, and votes weigh by shares.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the member account's rent; gets it back when the member leaves.

fields.name: reply_to
docs: Seq of the post this replies to (u64::MAX when it is not a reply).

fields.name: liked
docs: One bit per profile number: who liked it.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: Clashy-owned price feed. Delegated to the ER and updated about every second by the crank;
the crank commits it back to Solana periodically so base-layer reads stay fresh.

types.name: Profile
docs: A player's public face and the controls they set on themselves. Every stake checks it on chain:
the break, the daily limit, and the day streak.

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Most USDC (base units) this player can stake in one UTC day. Lowering applies at once.

fields.name: pending_limit
docs: A raise waits LIMIT_RAISE_DELAY before it applies (0 when none is pending).

fields.name: day
docs: UTC day index of `staked_today`.

fields.name: break_until
docs: No staking until this time (a break the player took).

fields.name: last_active_day
docs: Days in a row with at least one stake or save, and the best run.

fields.name: save_bps
docs: Share of each win the app moves to the Stash, in basis points (the player's own setting).

fields.name: roundup_step
docs: Round each payment up to this step and save the difference (USDC base units; 0 = off).

fields.name: number
docs: Order in which profiles were made (from the registry).

types.name: Stash
docs: The savings jar: USDC in a vault only its owner can take out, with a goal and a record of where
the money came from (put in, round-ups on payments, slices of wins).

types.name: Tournament
docs: An on-chain Royale: escrowed entries, up/down calls each round on the ER, last one standing.

fields.name: calls
docs: 0 no call, 1 up, 2 down, for the current round.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Lobby opened; after TOUR_LOBBY_SECS anyone can cancel an unstarted tournament (full refunds).

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the tournament vault's rent; gets it back when the vault closes.

fields.name: return_bps
docs: Return in basis points of the starting chest, recorded at settlement.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 none, 1 clan A, 2 clan B, 3 tie.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the war vault's rent; gets it back when the vault closes.
